_meta.title: Backroom A+B deduplicated QA — issue categories separated
_meta.scope: Research staging only. Original research and live listings.json not modified; stage output is NOT publication approval.
_meta.principles: Exact duplicates are excluded from new candidate set; duplicate source references are preserved for merge. Different issues have distinct categories; categories may overlap. Hold rows have verified named-place or approach GPS, not guaranteed pinpoint of sexual activity. Ambiguous flagged locations have no invented city-centre coordinates.
